Article health

Out of stock: sold 10+ in 30 days, no stock. Low cover: sold 10+, under 15 days of cover. WH out: sold 5+ online, no warehouse stock. No sale 90d: 10+ units, no sale in 90 days. Overstock: 30+ units, over 180 days of cover.
